record.body:
## Description

Rename Claude/Cursor plugin and marketplace identity to `affidavit`, set contract `"project": "affidavit"` with ensure-store foreign-contract gate, and retarget skills/AGENTS/README/CLAUDE product and CLI strings to `affidavit` / `aff`.

## Approach

1. Update `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`, and both marketplace.json files: name/displayName/`plugins[].name` → `affidavit`; keep adaptive-artifacts dependency entries.
2. Set `contract/project-design.json` `"project": "affidavit"`; copy to `.artifacts/project-design.json` on primary and run `adaptive-artifacts resolve` (parent/store writer).
3. Rewrite `skills/ensure-store.md` (and any skills gating on project id) so the foreign-contract stop compares to `affidavit`.
4. Replace user-facing `se-workflow` / `se-workflow check|close-batch` with `affidavit` / `aff …` across skills, AGENTS, CLAUDE, README, agents docs; update `scripts/sync-plugin.sh` target paths.
5. Do not rewrite historical `.artifacts/records` bodies; do not patch `~/adaptive-artifacts` (R6 Landing).

payload.title: Plugin, contract project id, and docs → affidavit
